_note: Lao interface catalogue. A partial overlay over en.json by contract. Built by tmp/lo/i18n.py, which asserts completeness against en.json, that every placeholder survives, that no category-Cf character is present, and that every Lao run parses through the same reader the pack rows go through. The studio, export and preview keys appended after that build were written by hand and are not yet in tmp/lo/i18n.py, so its completeness assertion needs the two deliberate gaps allowed for: preview.lockDate and preview.lockTime are left out on purpose, because the lock-screen mock now takes its sample date and time from CLDR and the English in en.json is only a floor for locales Intl has never heard of. ແຖບ does double duty as the head/foot band and as the tab, so the tab is ແຖບສີ wherever one sentence has to name both. Message-screen pass (board.slow, board.switch*, display.*): display.roman is ຕົວອັກສອນຂອງເຈົ້າເອງ «your own letters», because the line it switches is the card's say column -- the respelling in the reader's own script, as field.respell / field.title.respell already describe it -- and not the Latin romanisation; IPA stays ໄອພີເອ as in field.ipa; display.speak and display.turn name the controls as ປຸ່ມ, as editor.noListenerText already does.
